QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Dream Fragment
QuestInfo.0: Jay, whom you met in #bMutant Tiru Forest#k, has something to give you. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Jay handed you a #bDream Fragment#k, which he obtained in the process of absorbing the essence of black magic. What could it be for? #rAthena Pierce#k, in the #bHenesys Ruins#k, might know something.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Athena Pierce about the shiny Dream Fragment.

npc.0: Since Athena Pierce has lived for a very long time, she might know something about the Dream Fragment.
